{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) is a tight-tolerance fit feature, but the drawing specifies an I.Z.B.P. plating surface treatment with no allowance for coating thickness on this bore. Plating buildup will reduce the hole diameter and cause interference with the mating shaft or pin. The designer should either add a pre-plate machining allowance to the H7 dimension or explicitly call out masking of the bore before plating."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note specifying that the ⌀16 H7 bore shall be masked during plating, or increase the bore size by twice the maximum plating thickness so the finished hole meets H7 after coating."}]}
